description: For a well-ordered index type and injective component maps into one common type, least-index union coding is injective.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.Cofinality.unionCode_injective.{u, v, w} {ι : Type u} {α : Type v} {β : Type w} [LinearOrder ι]
  [WellFoundedLT ι] (A : ι → Set α) (e : (i : ι) → ↑(A i) → β) (he : ∀ (i : ι), Function.Injective (e i)) :
  Function.Injective (Lemmatheca.Entry.Cofinality.unionCode A e)
